product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow helps mid-market businesses collect multichannel customer feedback, analyze it with AI, and act on insights to improve customer experience.
product_one_liner.notes: The AWS case study identifies mid-market brands as the audience and describes combining feedback from multiple touchpoints with AI to identify insights and take action: https://startups.aws.com/learn/surveysparrow-turns-talk-into-traction-for-customer-experience.

pricing_page.notes: A public subscription pricing page exists: https://surveysparrow.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The AWS customer case study explicitly names Tata Digital and MotoGP as SurveySparrow customers: https://startups.aws.com/learn/surveysparrow-turns-talk-into-traction-for-customer-experience. | named_customers.0: The AWS case study explicitly identifies Tata Digital as a customer. | named_customers.1: The AWS case study explicitly identifies MotoGP as a customer.

employee_band.notes: SurveySparrow's LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees: https://linkedin.com/company/13253328.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly gives a San Francisco headquarters address: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai. | hq_country: The company's headquarters address is explicitly in San Francisco, USA: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2017: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying engineering posts describe actual implementation work: Mohamed Nainar, identified as a SurveySparrow SRE, explains SLO implementation across services (https://engineering.surveysparrow.com/building-reliability-together-why-slos-matter-f8c0eeab7400); Niranchan D of the DevOps team explains Jenkins-triggered Kubernetes jobs for sharded QA tests (https://engineering.surveysparrow.com/slashing-qa-runtimes-with-playwright-sharding-on-kubernetes-k8s-b11c447952e6).

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal covers REST APIs, SDKs, SpotChecks and embedding (https://developers.surveysparrow.com/). The knowledge center also contains multiple guide and article collections (https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/en).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The rendered official careers board lists 12 openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, LLM, machine-learning, data-science, NLP, computer-vision or scientist title: https://surveysparrow.keka.com/careers.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic Claude Sonnet via Amazon Bedrock.
model_provider.notes: SurveySparrow names OpenAI for US processing and Azure OpenAI for EU processing (https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai). Its AWS case study also identifies Anthropic Claude Sonnet through Amazon Bedrock for summarization, clustering and sentiment scoring (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/surveysparrow-turns-talk-into-traction-for-customer-experience).

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center names SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA and GDPR: https://security.surveysparrow.com/. The company specifies that HIPAA support requires a paid add-on and signed Business Associate Agreement: https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai. These are public compliance claims, not a claim that every plan includes HIPAA support. | compliance_certs.0: The company trust center explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The company trust center explicitly names ISO/IEC 27001. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is named in the trust center; the company says it is available through a paid add-on with a signed Business Associate Agreement. | compliance_certs.3: The company trust center explicitly names GDPR.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company describes the round as seed funding (https://surveysparrow.com/newsroom/surveysparrow-raises-seed-funding-from-prime-venture-partners), and the current funding summary identifies it as the latest round (https://millionrounds.com/company/surveysparrow). | funding_date: The funding summary identifies the latest round as April 2019, normalized to 2019-04: https://millionrounds.com/company/surveysparrow. | funding_amount_usd: The company announced $1.4 million in seed funding (https://surveysparrow.com/newsroom/surveysparrow-raises-seed-funding-from-prime-venture-partners). The funding summary, updated November 4, 2026, identifies this as the latest round (https://millionrounds.com/company/surveysparrow). $1.4 million equals USD 1,400,000.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding summary, updated November 4, 2026, lists only one round and identifies the latest as April 2019, outside the 18-month window: https://millionrounds.com/company/surveysparrow.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative - US posting is live at https://surveysparrow.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/90588 and also appears on the current official careers board at https://surveysparrow.keka.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced the launch of SparrowCRM on September 3, 2026, within the six-month window: https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/computers-technology-and-internet/surveysparrow-launches-sparrowcrm-the-ai-native-agentic-crm-for-r-1216253.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: no qualifying dated appointment or departure could be verified. The available executive listing at https://theorg.com/org/surveysparrow/teams/executive-leadership lacks start dates and does not establish a complete C-level/VP roster, so it cannot support a reliable negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: SurveySparrow lists Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and HubSpot among its CRM integrations (https://surveysparrow.com/facts-for-ai). Dynamics and HubSpot also have public integration material: https://support.surveysparrow.com/hc/en/articles/14505450863389-Integrating-MS-Dynamics-365-With-SurveySparrow and https://surveysparrow.com/apps/hubspot-survey-integration. These are integration signals, not proof of internal CRM deployment. | crm_stack_signal.0: Salesforce is explicitly named in the company's CRM integration list; this is an integration signal. | crm_stack_signal.1: Public product documentation explains enabling the MS Dynamics 365 integration. | crm_stack_signal.2: The public integration page explicitly describes connecting HubSpot with SurveySparrow.
